name: Shelf Talk
description: You pick up those little figures too? Don't look at me like that. Bring me a couple you can spare and we'll talk.

name: Odd Lots
description: A man out on the coast pays good money for the painted ones. Three Uncommon, any kind. Spares only, I'm not a monster.

name: Pocket Menagerie
description: He wants variety now. One of the raiders, one animal, one of the strange ones. Don't ask me what he does with them.

name: Full House
description: Soldiers and places, he says. A BEAR or USEC man, a landmark, and something Rare to go with it.

name: The Collector
description: Last one. He wants an Epic piece and an Ultra Rare one, and then he'll open the big case for you. I've seen it. You could fit a fridge in it.
